pages.title: Tools
pages.text: Tools (including weapons and shields) are a popular Implement choice. They will forever have whatever enchantments were on them at the time of the ritual, but will lose any additional enchantments when broken.

Implements meant to break blocks can now break multiple of those blocks at once; you can use the Implement key to cycle through options for this. You will also find tool Implements slightly faster to use than their mundane equivalents.
